  Keep PRs to one logical change. See CONTRIBUTING.md.
  Title must follow Conventional Commits, e.g. "feat(validator): add ECDSA root validator".
-->

## What and why

<!-- What does this change do, and what problem does it solve? -->

Closes #

## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new behavior
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `refactor` — no behavior change
- [ ] `test` — tests only
- [ ] `docs` — docs / ADRs only
- [ ] `chore` / `ci` / `build`

## Architecture impact

- [ ] No frozen decision in `docs/architecture.md` or `docs/decisions/` is affected
- [ ] Touches architecture — a new or superseding ADR is included in this PR and
      was agreed in an issue first (link: #)

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests were written **before** the implementation (strict TDD)
- [ ] New behavior is covered by tests
- [ ] `forge fmt --check` passes
- [ ] `forge build` passes
- [ ] `forge test` passes
- [ ] Docs / ADRs updated if needed
- [ ] Branch is up to date with `main`
- [ ] No AI-attribution trailers in commits
